_note: Leaves on the branches: links gathered by hand, one list to a station. THIS FILE IS WRITTEN, NOT GENERATED. branches-sciences.json and branches-arts.json are built from the PDFs and are overwritten whenever a book is rebuilt — which has happened three times in two days — so a link put in one of those would be destroyed without a word. It belongs here, where the builder never looks.
_keys: Keyed by volume and by SEFIRAH, not by the name of the discipline. The names move: Malchut was Law before the rework and is Political Science now, and a list keyed to the old name would have come away attached to nothing. A station does not move.

Malchut.label: David McCullough on George Washington
Malchut.note: The historian on Washington and the revolutionary war — the man who held command and gave it back, which is this station's whole question.
